1. Requirements (the brief): .superpowers/sdd/2026-08-28-cleaning-site-redesign/task-8-brief.md

THIS WAS A TRANSCRIPTION + APPEND TASK. The brief's Step 1 (contacts) and Step 2 (focus visibility, responsive, reduced motion) contain the complete final CSS. Both must have been APPENDED verbatim, in that order, at the END of the file, without disturbing Tasks 3-7's layers.

CASCADE ORDER IS THE CRITICAL CORRECTNESS PROPERTY HERE. Verify by line number, not by eye:
- The `@media (max-width: 900px)` and `@media (max-width: 640px)` blocks must appear AFTER every base rule they override (the card, hero, form, price and portfolio rules from Tasks 5-7, and `.header-container` / `.page-container` from Tasks 3-4). If any media query precedes a rule it targets, the responsive layout is silently dead. List the line numbers and confirm the ordering holds for each overridden selector.
- The `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block must be LAST in the file.
- `!important` must appear EXACTLY four times, all four inside the prefers-reduced-motion block. That block is the one permitted use — it is required for the accessibility override to win. Anywhere else is a defect.

Also verify:
- Character-level match between the brief's Step 1 + Step 2 CSS and what was added. Report drift as "brief says X, file has Y". Pay attention to: rgba(178, 106, 32, .16), rgba(255, 255, 255, .09), min-height 44px and 96px, padding 11px var(--s3), grid-template-columns 1.15fr .85fr, .98rem, 1.35rem, outline 2px / offset 2px, .01ms, and every var(--…) token name.
- Every var(--…) referenced in the appended block EXISTS in the :root block. List any missing.
- `.form-group input:focus` (Step 1, sets a box-shadow ring) and `.form-group input:focus-visible { outline: none }` (Step 2) must BOTH be present and must not have been merged. The inputs are meant to show a brass box-shadow ring rather than an outline. Confirm both exist and that the focus-visible override comes after.
- Cross-check the contacts selectors against the real markup in js/pages/contacts.js: .contacts-wrapper, .order-form, .form-grid-2, .form-group, #form-status, .contacts-info. Flag any rendered class with no rule, or any rule targeting a class the markup never produces. Do not modify that file.
- The append did not modify, reorder, or delete anything from Tasks 3-7. The file must still open with the "BusinessServices — Design System" banner and the :root block; `--ink:` exactly once; `header {` (Task 4) exactly once; `.portfolio-card {` (Task 7) exactly once.
- Braces balanced.
- No rule added that is not in the brief.

COMPLETENESS CHECK — this is the last CSS task, so now confirm the whole stylesheet is coherent:
Extract every class name referenced in markup across js/pages/*.js and js/components/index.js, and confirm each resolves to a rule in css/components.css. Report any class that renders with no styling. (Known and acceptable: classes whose styling is inherited or intentionally unstyled — use judgement and say which you consider acceptable.)

GLOBAL CONSTRAINTS that bind this task — your attention lens:
1. No content text changes — no .js file may be modified.
2. No structural changes — index.html must not be modified.
3. `frontend/` is a stale duplicate tree with its own css/ — must be entirely untouched.
6. Token values are exact — character-for-character from the brief.
7. Scope: ONLY css/components.css may be modified, and only by appending.

CONTEXT YOU NEED:
- The old stylesheet had ZERO focus rules. The `:focus-visible` block is new behaviour, not a duplicate.
- `#form-status` had its inline style stripped in Task 2, so this layer's rule is what styles it.
- js/components/header.js, footer.js and serviceCard.js were deliberately DELETED in Task 2 (dead duplicates nothing imported). js/components/index.js is the live component file.

ENVIRONMENT: no node, npm, or headless browser (python 3.14 only). The brief's Step 3 (tabbing for focus rings, submitting the form, toggling OS reduce-motion) is impossible here and was correctly deferred. Do not treat that as a spec failure — but DO flag it if the implementer claimed a browser check passed.

Report:
- SPEC COMPLIANCE: ✅ or ❌, with specifics.
- TASK QUALITY: Approved, or findings labelled Critical / Important / Minor.
- COMPLETENESS: the class-coverage result.
- Note any "⚠️ Cannot verify from diff" items separately.
Cite file:line. Do not suggest improvements beyond the task's scope.
